title: PF2E Scene Animation Manager
description:
PF2E Scene Animation Manager gives GMs a central, scene-based overview of Automated Animations configuration for Pathfinder Second Edition.

  • Browse PC and NPC spells, attacks, actions, and active feats.
  • Search and filter item overrides, global Autorec matches, disabled entries, and missing animations.
  • Open AA's existing item editor or global Autorec menu directly.
  • Group linked actors while keeping unlinked token actors separate.

Compatibility: Foundry VTT 14 (build 361 or later), PF2e 8.6.1+, and Automated Animations 7.1.8–7.x. Sequencer is required; AA also requires socketlib. JB2A Free or Patreon assets are optional for management and needed only when the selected animations use them.

GM-only, English interface. No animation renderer, live preview, or separate assignment database. Variant editing opens the base spell; temporary spells are read-only. Foundry runtime acceptance is still pending.

Setup and usage · Report an issue · Changelog

systems.reason: Uses PF2e actor items, prepared strikes, spellcasting collections, and spell variants.

requires.reason: Provides item animation configuration, global Autorec assignments, and the original editor.
Required by Automated Animations for its animation workflow.
